rows.title: Trading Window
rows.summary: Info Edge (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

rows.title: Diversification/Disinvestment
rows.summary: Info Edge (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
